summary: Round 2 of the root-path rival refutations (after PR-1197 and PR-1198) refuted three rivals from deeper premises (NO-OCCASIONALIST-MOVER-LINK-WITHOUT-CAUSE-FROM-EFFICIENT-MOVERS, NO-MOVED-NOT-POTENT-COUNTERTUPLE-FROM-ABILITY-AND-INCOMPLETENESS, NO-INERTIAL-UNIFORM-MOTION-WITHOUT-MOVER-FROM-STATE-READING) and attached refutes relations to the existing ELEATIC-THESIS-SELF-REFUTING and PER-SE-CAUSAL-LOOP-IMPOSSIBLE. The five rivals named here were examined and not refuted, for these reasons. (1) STMT-POTENCY-PRIOR-TO-ACT: the sourced reason for act's priority (ST I q.3 a.1, Metaphysics IX.8 1049b24-26: what is in potency is reduced to act only by a being in act, STMT-NOTHING-REDUCED-TO-ACT-EXCEPT-BY-A-BEING-IN-ACT) bears only on potencies being reduced; the rival's witness may be an idle potency, and a premise that every potency is posterior to a possible reducer restates STMT-ACT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-TO-POTENCY. (2) STMT-CAUSE-MOVES-WITHOUT-BEING-IN-ACT (emergentist): the deeper Aristotelian text, Metaphysics IX.8 'the mover already exists actually', is already the stating claim ARIST-MET-1049B-MOVER-ALREADY-ACTUAL-A of the rivalled premise STMT-NOTHING-MOVES-EXCEPT-AS-IN-ACT, so a refutation from it is from the target itself; the Physics III.2 form-as-source reading (STMT-MOVER-FORM-SOURCE-CAUSE-CHANGE) is untyped and needs a bridge 'carrying the form of r is being formally in act in r', which is exactly what the emergentist (virtual-act reading, DISAMB-IN-ACT) denies. (3) STMT-MOVED-MOVER-MOVES-NOT-AS-MOVED: Aquinas' own accidental-cause example supports it (AQUINAS-ST-I-Q46-A2-AD7-ACCIDENTAL-GENERATION-B); the corpus answer is the weaker sibling STMT-SECOND-MOVERS-MOVE-AS-MOVED-IN-RELEVANT-RESPECT, not a refutation, and any refuting premise would restate the strong reading. (4) STMT-INFINITE-PER-SE-CAUSE-SERIES: the Second Way's priority premises exclude only loops (PER-SE-CAUSAL-LOOP-IMPOSSIBLE) and INFINITE-LOCAL-TRANSMISSION-MODEL shows injective descent is consistent with local rules; the only deeper premises that exclude it are the causal-finitism bundle of FINITE-ANCESTRY-NO-LOOPS-PER-SE-NO-REGRESS, whose composition needs Mathlib's Set.Finite and hence propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound, outside this round's zero-axiom gate. A refutation from the target NoInfinitePerSeEfficientCauseSeriesReading itself (Acc excludes descent) would be from the rivalled premise. (5) STMT-OPINER-LACKS-ITS-OPINION-MOTION: no deeper premise about opining is in the corpus; a refutation would need a new bridge (opining actualizes a potency qua potency, with the Physics III.1 analysis) as strong as STMT-OPINION-IS-A-MOTION itself, and retorsion does not apply to a local countertuple.
blocker: (1) a sourced premise tying idle potency to a prior being in act; (2) a typed reading of Physics III.2 202a9-12 plus a form-possession/formal-act bridge, or a decision on DISAMB-IN-ACT; (3) none: the rival is answered by the weak sibling reading; (4) a separate result with the Mathlib axioms permitted, composing perSeNoRegressOfFiniteAncestry with Acc-excludes-descent; (5) a sourced analysis of opining (e.g. De Anima on thinking as being affected).
